Kids Bible Class · July — Week 4

The Story of the Persistent Widow

Luke 18:1-8

“Jesus said we should always pray and never give up.”

based on Luke 18:1 (NIrV)

We should always pray and never give up — God loves to hear us and answer.

Image 1

Jesus wanted to teach His friends something important about prayer.

He wanted them to know that they should always keep praying…

and never, ever give up. So He told them a story.

Image 2

In a certain town there was a judge whose job was to help people. But this judge didn't really care about anyone.

A widow in the town needed his help. She came to him and said, “Please help me! Someone has been unfair to me.”

But the judge just shrugged and ignored her.

Image 3

But the widow did not give up. Not even a little.

She came back the next day, and the next day, and the day after that.

Again and again she asked, “Please help me!” She was patient and she kept on trying.

Image 4

Finally the judge said to himself, “I don't really care about anyone…

but this woman keeps coming back and she will not give up!

All right — I will help her, just so she will be happy.” And he did!

Image 5

Then Jesus explained what the story meant. “Did you see? Even an unkind judge finally helped the woman who kept asking.

How much MORE will our loving God listen to His own children who pray to Him!”

So we should always pray and never give up. God hears us, He loves us, and He loves to answer!

What We Learn

The widow kept on asking and never gave up, and finally even the unkind judge helped her. Jesus said: if a grumpy judge will help someone who keeps asking, then our loving God — who cares about us so much — will surely listen to His children. So we never need to give up on praying.

For you: Keep talking to God and never stop praying, even when an answer takes a while. God always hears you, He loves you, and He loves to answer His children.
